bio: Designed the 18-point Devanagari typeface New Style Anant for Marathi at the Gujarati Type Foundry in Bombay between 1932 and 1937. Also cut 20-point italic faces.

sources.title: From the Collection: Gujarati Type Foundry’s 1937 Specimen Book - Letterform Archive
